candidates.name: Adverse local tissue reaction (ALTR) associated with metal-on-metal hip arthroplasty
support_spans: A metal artifact reduction sequence MRI revealed a left periprosthetic soft‐tissue mass measuring 9 × 8 × 10 cm, without bony involvement or bone‐marrow edema.
Serum cobalt and chromium levels were within normal limits.
candidates.why: The presence of a periprosthetic soft-tissue mass on MRI and elevated inflammatory markers suggest an adverse local tissue reaction.

candidates.name: Chronic inflammation or infection
support_spans: Laboratory studies showed an erythrocyte sedimentation rate of 22 mm/h (reference range, 2–28), a C‐reactive protein level of 14.4 mg/L (reference, <10.0)
Hip aspiration yielded 10,750 white cells/μL; all cultures were negative.
candidates.why: The elevated inflammatory markers and presence of white cells in the hip aspiration suggest chronic inflammation or infection.
